+/** Copies text through the async Clipboard API, falling back to execCommand on insecure origins. */
+export async function copyTextToClipboard(text: string): Promise<void> {
+    // Remote-control pages are served over plain HTTP, so navigator.clipboard is undefined there.
+    if (navigator.clipboard) {
+        try {
+            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
+            return
+        } catch {
+            // Fall through to the legacy path; it still works inside a user-gesture handler.
+        }
+    }
+
+    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea')
+    textarea.value = text
+    document.body.appendChild(textarea)
+    try {
+        textarea.select()
+        if (!document.execCommand('copy')) throw new Error('Clipboard copy was refused by the browser')
+    } finally {
+        textarea.remove()
+    }
+}

B_192 is stale as the original bug.

The Sentry event most likely came from “Copy path / Copy relative path”: that handler caught the missing `navigator.clipboard` error and reported it through `dialogService`, matching the recorded click stack. On September 12, it was changed to use the new fallback-enabled [clipboard_text.ts](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/services/clipboard_text.ts:2). Its five focused tests pass, including the missing-clipboard case.

However, the same failure remains possible in newer diagram copy/cut code, which still calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText` directly:

- [diagram_copy.ts](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/services/diagrams/diagram_copy.ts:14)
- [diagram_cut.ts](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/services/diagrams/diagram_cut.ts:17)

There is also a direct call in [markdown_paste_plugin.tsx](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/editor/markdown_paste_plugin.tsx:112), although that path is Electron-specific and less likely to encounter a missing Clipboard API.

Recommendation: don’t keep B_192 unchanged as a `new` card. Either:

- complete it as incidentally fixed by the September 12 clipboard fallback; or
- rewrite it as a small clipboard consolidation bug covering the remaining direct diagram calls.

No files were modified. I could not verify current recurrence data from the authenticated Sentry issue itself.
